ruling.lead: SCORECARD EXCEEDS PLAN: it converted an axis-scoped named comparator portfolio into an all-three, axis-blind prerequisite.

plan_anchors: SOTA = a pre-registered scorecard, versus named comparators, on axes with commissioned instruments.
Comparators pinned and priced: licensed Zerene (PMax *and* DMap
DMap has never rendered here and is A5's true comparator
the fork rebuilt at its best-known build
no occlusion veil above [bar] (halo instrument at full reach)
An open-source stacker is a useful foreign arm and repairs a real provenance defect, but it clears **no** blocker.
scorecard_anchors: The required set is exactly licensed Zerene Stacker PMax, licensed Zerene Stacker DMap, and a fresh fork rebuild
If any required arm — Zerene PMax, Zerene DMap, or the fresh commit-pinned best-known-source fork rebuild — cannot produce a linear output that passes §1.3
the named-comparator requirement is unmet and the dependent comparative axes remain `UNMEASURED`
SCORECARD ADDITION — UNRATIFIED. This rule is authored here and is not traceable to the owner's plan.
p99(a_e) no worse than the M1-qualified comparator envelope in every scope

candidates.name: Enfuse / Hugin
candidates.reason: The documented CLI accepts supplied TIFFs, supports focus-stack fusion, 16-bit output and identity-space blending. Defaults are not admissible, and no frozen binary/settings package has passed the scorecard ramp and geometry witnesses.

candidates.name: PetteriAimonen/focus-stack
candidates.reason: The pinned upstream loader omits IMREAD_ANYDEPTH and the inverse wavelet path converts to CV_8U. It cannot emit the required 16-bit linear result as-is.

candidates.name: ImageJ/Fiji Extended Depth of Field
candidates.reason: The official plugin is macro-callable and accepts an image stack, but its documentation does not establish a native-size 16-bit linear RGB TIFF plus profile path. Absence of that specification and of a §1.3 witness is fatal to admission.

candidates.name: ShineStacker
candidates.reason: Its public documentation promises batch processing and 16-bit TIFF input/output, but does not define linear-transfer or ICC identity; it also lists metadata limitations for 16-bit TIFF. A ramp/profile witness is required.

candidates.name: OpenCV-based stackers as a class
candidates.reason: OpenCV is an image-processing library, not a comparator. Each concrete stacker must prove unchanged-depth loading, linear arithmetic/output, metadata semantics, native geometry and §1.3 conformance; library choice supplies none of those by itself.

candidates.name: Stackaroni
candidates.reason: Its own README says samples are converted to linear on decode and re-encoded to sRGB on write. The scorecard requires a linear TIFF output, so the documented output contract fails.

candidates.name: z-stackr
candidates.reason: Its README says the classical pipeline deliberately stores and blends gamma-encoded sRGB values end to end and enables per-frame brightness/gamma correction by default. That is not the scorecard's linear common-input/output path.

candidates.name: PICOLAY
candidates.reason: The official manual says TIFFs are changed to 24-bit bitmaps internally and PICOLAY cannot save TIFF files.

candidates.name: CombineZP
candidates.reason: The existing repository audit found only 24/32-bit RGB storage/export paths, not 16-bit-per-channel linear RGB.

candidates.name: ChimpStackr
candidates.reason: Public claims of a 16-bit pipeline do not establish linear transfer, profile identity or the scorecard ramp. The repository's licence discipline precludes a fresh source audit in this lane, so admission evidence is absent.

enfuse_admission_work: render_all_registered common_input captures only after admission
